datalist.name: Relentless Hunger
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 150
- Can gain up to 50 Stacks per turn

datalist.name: Noble Dignity
datalist.desc:
Gain all of the following effects based on Pulsation Potency on self:
- 2+: Take -25% damage from Bleed
- 3+: Base Skills inflict +1 more Bleed Potency and Count
- 4+: Base Skill Base Power +1

- Min & Max Speed +1
- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, this unit's HP does not drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter)

- Apply the following effects to "Le Rouge" allied Identities (including this unit):
  · Min & Max Speed +1
  · If there is not enough Charge Count to activate the effects of Skills that consume Charge Count, consume 1 Buffet to gain 1 Charge Count for every missing Charge Count required for activation
datalist.summary: Strengthen Base Skills under certain conditions

datalist.name: L'Abject
datalist.desc:
- Unique Bleed
- Max Stack: 5
- Take +2% damage from "Le Rouge" Identities for every Stack (max 10%)
- Turn Start: Gain +1 Bleed Count
- Turn End: Gain (Stack / 2) Bind next turn (rounded down)
- Turn Start: If Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is not on the field, this effect expires

datalist.name: Uncontrollable Rampage
datalist.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Offense Level +1 for every Stack (max 3)
- Min & Max Speed +1
- Deal +1% damage for every Bleed on self (max 15%)

- Cannot become Staggered (excluding forced Stagger)
- Take -50% damage from Bleed
- Cannot be defeated by Bleed damage

- On Base Attack Skill Use, gain +3 Bleed Count
- On Base Attack Skill Hit, gain Bleed equal to Uncontrollable Rampage Stack

- Turn End: Lose 1 Count
datalist.summary:
On Base Attack Skill Use, gain Bleed Count
On Base Attack Skill Hit, gain Bleed equal to Uncontrollable Rampage Stack

datalist.name: Buffet
datalist.desc:
- Max Value: 999
- This value is increased by (actual HP healed / 10) whenever allies' or enemies' HP is healed on the field
 · Max 100 per instance of healing
 · Rounded up for each instance
 · Healing from E.G.O Gifts does not count

- This value is shared by all characters
- Resets when moving to a different zone
datalist.flavor: The Buffet of flesh and meat is served. Let this be a feasting hall for all.

datalist.name: Attending the Divine
datalist.desc:
- Unique Assist Defense
- Max Stack: 1

- When Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is about to take an Unopposed Attack from an enemy, consume 1 Stack to redirect the enemy's targeting to self
 · Then, copy and use Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair's "La Garde"
- When there are multiple allies that have Assist Defense Stacks, the ally that has the highest Stack has the highest activation priority
- This effect counts as Assist Defense, and is counted toward calculating Assist Defense Stacks

- Turn End: This effect expires
datalist.flavor: Let us attend to our new God.

datalist.name: Desperate Hunger
datalist.desc:
- Offense Level +2

- At Coin Start of a Base Attack Skill used against an enemy, consume 1 Charge Count to deal +5% damage
 · Skills that inflict Bleed Potency or Count deal +10% damage instead (including Unique Bleed)
 · At 1+ Buffet Value on the field, if this unit is not at max Charge Count, consume 1 Buffet to gain +1 Charge Count
 · If both Charge Count and Buffet are at 0, consume 1% HP on self instead to activate the effect (rounded down; damage dealt by this effect does not Stagger or reduce this unit's HP below 1; activates even at 1 HP)

- Turn End: This effect expires
datalist.summary: Consume Charge Count to deal more damage
datalist.flavor:
The sharper one hungers, the fiercer the desperation.
The further one is driven, the deeper the longing.

datalist.name: Crimson Cradle
datalist.desc:
When conditions are met by other "Le Rouge" allies, activate corresponding effects for Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair
- Effects remain active even if the corresponding ally is defeated

Le Rouge Ishmael
- If Ishmael is in "Full Makeover" state, Sinclair's max HP +10%; Sinclair heals 5% max HP On Base Attack Hit (rounded up, 5 times per turn)
